title: Grade 2 Life Skills — Making Safe and Kind Choices Online
subject: General Knowledge and Life Skills
description: Practice with questions on privacy, permission, passwords, trustworthy adults.
creator: Teach Arcade

questions.question: A game chat asks for your home address. What should you do?
choices: Post it in the chat.
Use it as your game name.
Keep it private and tell a trusted adult.
Ask strangers to send theirs first.

questions.question: A link says you won a prize you never entered. What is a safe first step?
choices: Open it right away.
Ask a trusted adult before opening it.
Send it to the whole class.
Enter your password.

questions.question: What makes a strong, memorable password choice with adult guidance?
choices: your first name
your favorite team alone
the word password
a long password that is hard to guess

questions.question: What should you do before sharing a friend's photo online?
choices: ask permission and follow your adult's or school's rules
send it to people you do not know
post it before the friend sees it
add their address to the post

questions.question: Someone sends a mean message. What is a helpful response?
choices: share it to embarrass them
stop replying and tell a trusted adult
give them your account details
send a meaner message

questions.question: What should you do when done with a signed-in account on a shared device?
choices: sign out
post your login on the screen
leave it open for the next person
change someone else's password

questions.question: What information should stay private in a public chat?
choices: your phone number
a color you like
the weather where no location is given
the name of your favorite fruit

questions.question: Which comment is respectful?
choices: “Only someone silly would say that.”
“Go away and never try again.”
“I will make everyone laugh at you.”
“I think the answer is different because of this clue.”

questions.question: What can you do if a website asks to use your camera unexpectedly?
choices: keep clicking until the warning is gone
invite it to use your microphone too
allow it every time
decline and check with a trusted adult

questions.question: An unverified post says the library is closed. What source should you check?
choices: the library's own website or phone line
the username with the most emojis
an unrelated game page
the oldest forwarded message

questions.question: What does a digital footprint include?
choices: your device's weight
traces left by things people do online
only words written on paper
only shoeprints near a computer

questions.question: Why think before posting?
choices: Posts never affect anyone else.
Other people may copy or share what you post.
Deleting a post always removes every copy.
Posts are always visible only to you.

questions.question: What should you do if a username includes your full name and birth date?
choices: post the birth date in more chats
include your home address too
make the name your password
ask a trusted adult about using a safer name

questions.question: Which is a good first step if a pop-up asks you to download something unexpected?
choices: press every button
announce your password
download the file on a friend's device
stop and ask a trusted adult

questions.question: You use a drawing someone else made in a class project. What is responsible?
choices: claim you drew it
sell it as your own work
follow permission rules and credit the creator
erase the artist's name and repost it

questions.question: Someone you met only in a game asks to meet in person. What should you do?
choices: go alone
send them your school schedule
tell a trusted adult and do not arrange a meeting yourself
agree to keep it secret

questions.question: What helps when an online message is hard to understand?
choices: respond with an insult
immediately share it with everyone
ask what the person meant in a polite way
assume it can only mean one thing

questions.question: Which choice helps you balance device time with rest?
choices: keep using it while crossing a street
take a break when the agreed time is up
ignore all break reminders
use the device through bedtime secretly

questions.question: What should you do if a chat message says it came from your teacher and requests your password?
choices: check with the teacher another way and keep your password private
put the password in a public channel
send the password because the name looks right
ask a classmate to send theirs too

questions.question: What helps you secure your own account if you think someone else used it?
choices: reuse the same password everywhere
remove all protection
tell a trusted adult and ask for help updating the password
hide the problem and share the account again
